summary: Product page for an automation dashboard in seven blocks: a head with a video, a pain-point wheel, a 10-feature grid, a two-tab audience block, a why-choose list with a screenshot and a contact band with a named expert. Needs a demo video, six pain points, ten features and two audience tabs.
